gross_margin.note: Etsy fees take $1.31 of $9 (85% margin); an Offsite Ads sale drops it to 70%

ltv_cac.note: Etsy Ads CAC ~$12 vs ~$9.2 LTV (0.77); only path to fix is unpaid organic search and Pinterest

pricing_power.note: $9 sits above the $7.99 median; $0.99 listings and PLR bundles anchor prices low

build_effort.note: A planner can be made in Canva and listed within days; tutorials abound

skills_match.note: No design track record; template design and Etsy SEO are learnable

capital_needed.note: $0.20 listings and a $15 setup fee fit the $300 budget with room

time_to_mvp.note: First listings live in 1-2 weeks at 8 h/week

channel_readiness.note: No audience; new shop competes with 866k listings in Etsy search (R5: no_distribution)

search_demand.note: 22,200 Etsy searches/month for 'digital planners'; r/GoodNotes ~110k members

trend.note: Category grows ~8%/yr per a vendor report, but Etsy active buyers only +1% YoY

willingness_to_pay.note: Buyers pay, but niche medians are $4.99-$7.97 and free 2026 PDFs exist

free_alternatives.note: Free 2026 planner PDFs (Passion Planner, Gumroad) do the job (R1)

competitor_density.note: 866k listings; 'ADHD planner' listings grew 13% in 30 days

differentiation.note: No edge stated; 7,500-page PLR bundles let anyone clone a catalog (R3)

legal_regulatory.note: Creativity Standards: own designs only, AI disclosure, no resold PLR; tax collected by Etsy

platform_dependency.note: One platform; a planner shop lost ~90% of Etsy sales in 2021 and shut in 2025

market_risk.note: Recurring yearly need, but sharp Dec-Jan seasonality; Etsy de-weighting digital items

skills.note: No stated design, Etsy SEO or Pinterest experience

assets.note: No audience, list, data or network

interest.note: Stated goal is side income, no domain passion

tam.reasoning: Global digital planners category, 2025 (vendor report; WiseGuy gives $3.42B for planner apps, another definition)

sam.reasoning: TAM $1.27B x 35% US share (assumption) x 10% sold via Etsy (assumption)

som.reasoning: Bottom-up: 15 sales/month (new-shop base case) x 12 x $9; top-down 0.1% of SAM ($44k) exceeds what top shops sell

demand_trend.value: flat, seasonal: 40,500 searches Dec-Jan vs 14,800 in spring

variable_cost_per_unit.reasoning: 6.5% transaction ($0.585) + 3% + $0.25 processing ($0.52) + $0.20 listing renewal = $1.31; Offsite Ads adds 15% ($1.35)

expected_lifetime.reasoning: One-off yearly product; assume 1 in 5 buyers buys a second item

conversion_rate_pct.reasoning: Midpoint of vendor benchmark 1.5-4% for digital bundles (InsightAgent); vendor data conflicts

payback_months.reasoning: One-off: gross profit $7.69 per order < CAC $12, so a paid customer never pays back

fixed_costs_month.reasoning: 20 listings x $0.20 renewal every 4 months = $1/month; Canva free plan; one-off $15 setup fee

break_even_customers_per_month.reasoning: $1 fixed / $7.69 per order; a $500/month side income needs 65 sales/month

time_to_first_revenue_weeks.reasoning: 2 weeks to list 5-10 planners + 2-6 weeks for organic Etsy search to index a new shop

type_checks.note: Organic order nets $7.69 (85%); an Etsy Ads order at ~$12 CAC loses ~$4.30, an Offsite Ads order nets $6.34
No shipping; digital downloads are typically set non-returnable, though faulty files must be refunded by the seller

rules_applied.effect: total 57 capped at 49: LTV:CAC 0.77 and no channel

confidence.note: Etsy pages returned 403, so shop sales counts and fee rates come from search snippets and fee guides; real CPC and conversion data would raise it

cheapest_test: List 3 planners for one narrow niche with 0 ad spend, pin 15 Pins, and count views, favorites and sales over 7 days
kill_criteria: Fewer than 300 total listing views by day 7 -> stop adding listings
0 sales from 10 listings by day 30 -> archive it
Fewer than 10 sales/month by day 90 -> archive it
Etsy Ads CAC above $7.70 after $30 spend -> turn ads off

rescue.change: One narrow niche (e.g. a planner for one profession) priced $12-15, with a Pinterest channel built before listing
rescue.why: Lifts differentiation, pricing_power and channel_readiness; organic CAC clears no_distribution and R6
rescue.requires: A niche with fewer than 5,000 listings, 30+ Pins a month for 3 months

rescue.change: Sell custom, personalised planners (names, dates, layouts on request) at $25-40 instead of generic files
rescue.why: Escapes the $0.99 PLR price anchor and the free_alternative; clone-proof because each is made to order
rescue.requires: Design skill and 1-2 hours of work per order, which caps income at 8 h/week
